alarm_manager.mechanism: AlarmManager with setAndAllowWhileIdle(RTC_WAKEUP) and fallback to set()
alarm_manager.battery_impact: NEGLIGIBLE (single wake event at requested offset)
alarm_manager.play_store_policy_risk: ZERO (no SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM / USE_EXACT_ALARM declared in manifest)
pros: Fires reliably at designated epoch timestamp even in low-power idle

cons: WorkManager is not an alarm clock; Android OS may delay execution by 10 to 30 minutes during Doze mode
A 15-minute departure reminder delayed by 15 minutes arrives after the bus has departed
Introduces heavyweight database and worker orchestration

security_enforcement: Explicit PendingIntent to TransitReminderReceiver, FLAG_IMMUTABLE, no exported receivers.
